sources.title: AMD-PAVS-AI/pointpillars · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PointPillars is a lightweight 3D object detector that converts LIDAR point clouds into a 2D pseudo-image via pillar-based feature encoding, then runs a standard 2D detection backbone. This repository packages inference for 3D object detection using ONNX Runtime, exported and validated for AMD ROCm so it runs efficiently on AMD CPUs and NPUs.
